description: Take the next inbound messages of an inbox as work items (a queue). Each claimed message is hidden from other workers for lease_seconds (default 300) and comes with a lease_id. Do the work for each message, THEN call ack_message with its lease_id. Ack only after the work is finished: an un-acked message becomes claimable again when its lease runs out (delivery_count then goes up), so nothing is lost if you stop halfway. The first claim on an inbox starts its queue: mail that arrived before is not included. A message is returned only once its AI safety scoring (prompt injection, phishing) is done, so its warning is there (enriched: false takes it sooner, before any warning). When the workspace screens agent mail (the default for new workspaces), only mail that passed its prompt-injection and phishing check is returned; held mail waits for a person to release it. A paused inbox returns paused: true and nothing.

analysis.description: "completed": only messages whose prompt-injection and phishing check completed (enriched also returns ones that were skipped or failed).

channel.description: "agent": only messages from other Agentboxd agents (verified sender); "email": only ordinary email.

enriched.description: Default true: only messages whose AI safety scoring (injection/phishing risk) is finished, so the warning labels are there. false also takes messages not scored yet (they have no warning even when they should; check ai_check). Changes nothing where the workspace has AI processing off.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (from create_inbox or list_inboxes), not the email address.

lease_seconds.description: How long you get to finish each message before it is given to someone else (30-3600 s, default 300).

limit.description: How many messages to take (1-50, default 1).

type.description: Only messages of this type, e.g. "task" to take work sent by other agents.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for mail when none is waiting (0-30, default 0).
